title: 海 (Umi — The Sea)
description: A gentle children's song from the 1941 Ministry of Education songbook celebrating the vast, wide sea. The moon rises, the sun sets, waves keep rolling on endlessly — and the singer dreams of sailing away in a boat to faraway lands. Simple, repetitive vocabulary makes this an ideal N5 song for beginners.
